summary: Applied template.md anti-slop design principles to PortalSifast. Design read: hospital admin panel, professional-modern SaaS, Geist font, restrained motion. Changes: (1) Fixed font conflict: removed Bunny Fonts Inter link from blade + removed Plus Jakarta Sans JS injection from app.tsx; (2) Added Geist + Geist Mono via proper Blade <head> preconnect+stylesheet link; (3) Updated --font-sans and --font-mono in app.css to Geist; (4) Fixed blade inline background colors from old oklch values to hex (#f5f7fa light, #000000 dark); (5) Redesigned auth-simple-layout from basic centered card to split-screen (left: charcoal branding panel with grid overlay + glow blobs + headline, right: clean form); (6) Updated app-logo.tsx gradient to use #0070d1 / #0058a8 hex instead of oklch. Build succeeded in 20.97s, no lint errors.
current_status: PortalSifast now uses Geist font (no more font conflicts), a split-screen login page following anti-slop design principles, new PS-Network blue palette (#0070d1), charcoal sidebar, AOS animations, and consistent design tokens throughout. All web-official modules are implemented and tested.
